Hello again! For the next commission I was hoping for an image of my OC, Chartreuse, a guard who can be either exceptionally intense or very relaxed and sarcastic with not much in between.

As opposed to being a suit of armor, her outfit is more of a "suit AND armor" with a high shirt collar that blends into the rest of her armor/suit - you are free to play around with the design a bit if you would like. If possible, I would love it if she could be wearing a pair of rimless thin rectangular sunglasses but that is optional.

I am hoping to have her wearing the linked alternate gauntlets and to have the overall color scheme of her armor to be darker (gunmetal black) with electric green accents.

She is more of a tanned character with a strong build, visually.
